zed1 map 720p vs 1080p

The actual nvblox meshes, with the colours nvblox stored in them. Built from zed1 only with the Spot launch parameters (2 cm voxel), same scene, about 110 s each. Left is the 720p grab, right is the 1080p grab. Both halves share one camera: drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan.
